[See docs/DISCLAIMER_SNIPPET.md](../DISCLAIMER_SNIPPET.md)
This repository is a conceptual research prototype. References to "AGI" and "superintelligence" describe aspirational goals and do not indicate the presence of a real general intelligence. Use at your own risk. Nothing herein constitutes financial advice. MontrealAI and the maintainers accept no liability for losses incurred from using this software.

# Summary

A completed mission can leave a reusable method, but finding, checking and maintaining that method can cost more than it saves. This edition makes that tradeoff executable and preserves the cases where a simpler specialist wins.

This draft adds **AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL — Strategy as a Productive Asset** exclusively under `studies/agi-alpha-flywheel-strategy-succession-v1/`: the 22-page author PDF, complete LaTeX/bibliography/editable vector figures, frozen protocol, runnable research companion, offline browser planner, separate checker, completed summaries, independent audits and evidence docket. The first browser action computes and checks an editable nine-job release schedule without an account, installation, wallet or API key. A finite six-mission mode runs actual discovery and selective admission; a separate construction diagnostic visibly permits correctness-only retention.

The companion executes the unchanged released **v1.42.0 `createWorkbench` closure at `c352bad0a0941fdccd490a7224e3efd1b8de45d5`**. It does not install or replace the native runtime. Preferred Edition02, historical experiments, native #4891, contracts, compatibility pins, root dependencies, workflows and publication infrastructure remain unchanged. This executable source addition requires full software qualification; it is not a passive paper-only import or a deployed website.

## Completed findings

The prospectively frozen campaign ran **12 paired streams × 72 offered missions**, eight arms and three cumulative work limits, followed by four diagnostic ancestry treatments: **336 completed stream/treatment executions** in total. It also executed **72 native reference calls** on 36 fixed tasks. There was one explicit launch and **zero manually triggered intermediate phases**. No post-launch exclusions or tuning were applied.

At the primary **1,000,000 declared work-unit cap per stream**:

| Method | Qualified / offered | Total charged work | Retained assets |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Strong fixed portfolio | **591 / 864** | 11,719,575 | 0 |
| Conventional saved workflow | 465 / 864 | 11,749,635 | 0 |
| Equally enabled conventional learner | 517 / 864 | 11,714,786 | 0 |
| Selective flywheel | 517 / 864 | 11,714,786 | 0 |

The registered flywheel-minus-saved-workflow contrast is **+4.33 qualified missions per stream**, with a paired stream-bootstrap 95% interval of **[3.67, 4.92]**. The flywheel ties the equally enabled learner and loses to the fixed portfolio. Its 12 discovery stages produce **no complete nominee**, so this contrast cannot be attributed to newly retained capability. The no-discovery ablation also qualifies 591/864. At the descriptive 2,000,000-unit cap, every arm qualifies the same **668/864**, while the flywheel costs **16.10% more** than the fixed portfolio.

The separate correctness-only diagnostic constructs **12 typed dispatch → lookahead → repair lineages**. All 12 fresh lookahead missions invoke inherited dispatch and three qualify. Four repair qualification outputs both use their parent and qualify; **zero fresh repair missions do both**. Ten retained stable repairs ignore the lookahead parent at delivery. Inheritance costs **60.35% less than exact reconstruction**, but the parent-removed conventional fallback qualifies **37/48**, versus **36/48** for inherited methods, at mean work **225,339.3 versus 888,009.5**. Equivalent replacements preserve the fresh schedules. Typed ancestry and conditional reconstruction savings are not a demonstrated deep-succession delivery advantage or full-investment payback.

The established native specialist qualifies **31/36 deadlines**, compared with **27/36** for the fixed interpreted portfolio. Mean deadline-workflow time including the known portfolio fallback is **298.24 ms**; makespan-mode end-to-end time is **1,021.78 ms**, with a separate **405.02 ms** shared process startup. Makespan mode reports 29 optimal statuses and seven time-limited incumbents. Returned schedules are independently checked; native infeasibility/optimality statuses are solver reports, not independently verified proof certificates. These physical timings are not equated with the primary abstract work tariff.

Full charged costs retain discovery, failed proposals, checking, retrieval, checkpoint/evidence storage and admission work. Primary flywheel discovery consumes **829,427 units**, while checkpoint serialization consumes **5,238,180 units (44.71%)**. The full campaign takes **844.40 seconds elapsed** and **751.10 seconds measured Node CPU**. Common WORLD generation adds 3,464,226 known baseline-generation units outside the conditional per-arm tariff. Python CPU total, authoring/setup/review labor and monetary cost remain unknown. No commercial growth, endogenous earned-resource reinvestment or increasing growth rate is established.

## Scope and remaining engineering gates

The original confirmation remains immutable. As recorded by the existing receiving owner in [6390964216](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/issues/4850#issuecomment-6390964216), the earlier development-checkpoint defects are fixed in this frozen source. Three further product gates remain unfulfilled: protected separate service/improvement accounts; repair bound to the actual preceding accepted project plan; and authenticated browser delivery to an explicitly approved executor. This study uses a shared cumulative account with stage caps, independently generated repair baselines and local browser/source execution. It does not claim those broader integrations.

A descendant inherits permitted artifacts and historical evidence, not current proof status or production authority. The four-repository/five-contract discussion is source inspection only; no EVM execution, signed settlement, wallet action or live financial transaction was exercised. Jobs' AGIALPHA and Manager's USDC paths remain distinct. Synthetic plans are computational outputs, not physical construction or paid demand.

## Source and artifact identities

- Canonical public companion (prepared, not released): **138,646,594 bytes**, SHA-256 `f22dcec10eff1653f4fbc70d3ac639d49b270a9fadb0b60e10f3fbb6fac2eaf8`; 310 outer files, 67 raw shards and 2,622 verified raw members.
- Final source payload: **239 files / 7,514,135 bytes**; manifest SHA-256 `2f7e7b7676f81ec608fa8f1e9d4179fecdb9638a814e579058d625044df182bd`.

The source PR includes the exact raw-evidence index and extraction guide; large trial records and earlier screenshots belong to a **separate raw research-release handoff**. The complete user package retains all originals and raw data. The public companion has passed complete outer/inner byte and manifest verification; its raw archive index is `43d82e7176a816a1e1b46776586abe57840f7cc8229a465841eb2a28de74b518`. The broader full user-delivery archive awaits the actual source-PR receipt before its final build. No public asset URL or completed release is claimed here. Raw/exposure-check reproduction requires restoring the matching archived paths, while the first browser mission and frozen-source verification work without them.

The receiving baseline was freshly checked at **2026-10-25 00:08 UTC**: main `5499495911bf8822ac0aa8c9007f00789c1132b5`, tree `2258d812b2397cad3055fd56d88183b55ad731f5`; the new study namespace was absent. The actual source commit/tree will be identified by this draft's Git history and final payload manifest, not inferred from the scientific-source digest.

# Checks

Local hook checks are recommended, not a prerequisite for opening a draft or pull request. The following integration checks have not been run on a final repository candidate. Required hosted merge and release checks remain unchanged; this disclosure does not waive them.

- [ ] I ran `pre-commit run --files <paths>` — not run on this integration candidate.
- [ ] I ran `pre-commit run --all-files` — not run for the isolated research build.
- [ ] I ran `python check_env.py --auto-install` — not run; this study did not install the repository environment.
- [ ] I ran `pytest --cov --cov-report=xml` and documented failures — no full repository coverage campaign claimed.
- [ ] `PR CI / Lint (ruff)` and `PR CI / Smoke tests` are green — pending the actual source PR checks.
- [ ] Exact candidate configured review and required resulting-main/software/site gates — pending the existing owner process.

# Testing

- **Frozen source and independent audit:** all 52 scientific/browser files verify. The original 336 trial artifacts and registered summaries were independently rechecked, with the repair parent-use interpretation narrowed in `review/results/ANCESTRY_EXECUTION_AUDIT.json` and `POST_RUN_REVIEW_STATUS.json`. No producer source or raw result was changed. Checker/reviewer separation is stated; this is not independent institutional replication.
- **Browser:** before confirmation, 18 checker assertions, 11 useful-plan/authority/layout checks, eight STOP/reload/resume/selective/diagnostic checks and five generic table-renderer checks passed. The final recorded-data HTML separately passes six focused checks and six exact JSON downloads on desktop/mobile, with no network requests or page errors. Live computation and recorded evidence remain visibly separate.
- **Recovery:** 12 source-bound operating checks pass, including process restart, lost acknowledgement, duplicate requests, changed dependency, invalid receipt, exhausted budget and expired authority. Their original pre-confirmation source identity and failures remain recorded; no broader acceptance is inferred. The same-HTML browser resume failure is preserved. Its regenerated fixture count changed from 6,096 to 6,115; frozen explicit fixtures remove that configuration drift without inventing an underlying engine cause.
- **Finite load:** batches of 1, 4, 16 and 64, with at most four checker processes, produce **85/85 valid plans and 68/85 qualified plans**. Throughput increases from 21.06 to 56.95 tasks/s, while p95 latency increases from 37.63 to 1,018.46 ms. No mid-batch manual intervention occurs. These are local finite observations, not sustained-service scaling evidence.
- **Historical foundation:** the recovered original Strategy Laboratory passes fresh original-policy replay on CPython 3.13.5: six attempts and **27,648 confirmation cases** with exact non-timing equality. The separate **193,536-artifact audit** retains its own scope. Neither is relabeled a new historical acquisition-search experiment.
- **Paper and packaging:** all 22 final PDF pages pass recorded visual inspection in `publication/pdf-qa/FINAL_ALL_PAGES.json`; the clean packaged-source rebuild is byte-identical to the author PDF (`publication/PACKAGED_LATEX_REBUILD.json`). Ten focused safe-extraction/shard tests pass. The final browser HTML, LaTeX ZIP and vector ZIP have exact durable readbacks. The separately served PDF adds provenance metadata; its 22 page renders, text and links match, and the canonical author PDF remains byte-identical inside the LaTeX ZIP. The complete research archive awaits the actual additive PR receipt; its identity is not guessed.

## Review and publication boundary

Please review this as an isolated research-source/evidence addition. The existing issue #4850 coordinator retains shared catalogue, merge and publication ownership. Native #4891 merged normally, but its existing owner retains the 1.43 exact-main publication window through actual public-artifact installation ([6391011522](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/issues/4850#issuecomment-6391011522)). This draft starts no publisher, merge or release dispatch.

Passive PDF import, research-release assets and new hosted HTML have separate policy gates. No deployed URL is claimed before owner-led publication and served/downloaded-byte verification. Original Harness/Fleet restrictions, unresolved findings and the five static pins/four unqualified native outcomes remain unchanged. Closing the browser or local process stops its computation; a saved checkpoint is not an unattended service.


## Final delivery receipt

The complete user-delivery archive is built, manifest-checked and read back with an exact hash: **140,892,374 bytes**, SHA-256 `c3cd68bce98626a10ae8e7110689f16c3ca0bfcbe142aea3c156f96e316f7529`. Its 2,954 payload files include the authoritative PDF, original historical materials, all raw results and the actual draft-PR creation receipt. All 59 docket references verify. The public companion also has an exact durable readback; neither archive is claimed as a published GitHub release asset. Source head remains `d69133291d72942c7d5f6be8ee0571cd83267110`, tree `9a152ea727c7231d7ef7e69df94924943716847c`, and all 239 added paths are confined to the new study namespace. The previous prepared-stage wording describes the state before this final receipt. No merge, release or deployment is included.
